newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says total foreign debt down to $27.4 billion.
newsitem.headline: Peru says total foreign debt down to $27.4 billion.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Tuesday the country's total private and public foreign debt was $27.436 billion at the end of March, down from $33.513 billion at the end of last year.
The drop is mainly due to the formal closing in early March of Peru's Brady Plan to reduce and restructure its foreign commercial debt.
The bank added in its weekly report that the current debt total represented 44.9 percent of total Gross Domestic Product, down from 55 percent at the end of the year.
Of $22.389 billion medium- and long-term debt, $19.513 billion corresponds to the public sector, $1.908 billion to the private sector and $968 million to the central bank.
Of $5.047 billion short-term debt, $2.120 billion corresponds to the private financial system, $70 million to the central bank and $2.857 billion to "others," the bank said.
